notes: Shaun, 2026-09-13, after the 9b sitting. Half marks where the student clearly knew the word but got the form wrong: a dropped or wrong particle, the wrong word class, a misspelling, a missing infinitive marker. Nothing for a different word or a blank. 'likely' is accepted for 'to be likely'; 'on my own' and 'on your own' for 'on one's own' — but NOT 'by my self' or 'by your own', which are the wrong preposition, not a slip. Section C (five sentences) is teacher-marked at 2 points each, so the test is out of 30, not 20. The devtools flag is ignored because it is broken: it reports exactly the same value as the typing-anomaly flag on every row, so it is not measuring devtools at all.
